data.name: Karthi
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Karthi means 'Son of God'. This powerful name is derived from the Hindu deity Kartikeya, also known as Murugan or Skanda, who is the god of war, courage, and wisdom. Karthi embodies the divine qualities of bravery, strength, and intelligence.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of divine courage and wisdom.
